items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: Who was in the Blue Parody? ... Joe Quaglina was on third alto or first alto. ... And I was on guitar

ctx.x: He's a very fine piano player. Very fine pianist. He still plays. He's around still playing. His brother played lead alto sax and clarinet. I don't know if the brothers playing sax and clarinet any more, but Joe, the leader of the group, was a very fine musician.
Do you remember his brother's name?
